label: Briefing
description: Fragt ab, was gebraucht wird — Recherche- oder Kreativ-Briefing — und gießt es in eine feste Struktur.
_status: A TEST, and meant to be rewritten. Two kinds of briefing live in the skill:
recherche/ and kreativ/. The research catalogue is real content — its
questions come from what a research order actually needs to be executable
(angles, source criteria, a stopping rule). The creative one is a generic
placeholder until real briefings show what belongs in it.
Both are ordinary files under agents/skills/briefing/. Improving them is
editing prose — no rollout of code, no rebuild.
The research brief is also the ORDER a research agent will later work from.
That is why it goes first: its structure is derivable, and its output is
immediately useful to the next agent rather than only to a person.
_why_tools: read only. It reads its question catalogue and its template, and hands the
finished briefing back in the chat. No write tool: a briefing that the
agent files away somewhere is a briefing nobody reviewed, and there is no
reason yet to spend that risk. If persisting it turns out to matter, that
is one narrow tool later, not a wide one now.
No pipeline tools either. This agent gathers and structures; it does not
produce. Whether a briefing should be able to start a flow is a real
question, and it is not answered by giving it the ability first.
_why_model: Local, and that is the whole of the choice: the agent hears what a client
wants before anyone has decided what is public. Nominal string, as always —
the weights behind the port are whatever profile is loaded.
